title: The chessboard rice legend ends at a mountain of grain
body: One grain doubled per square reaches 2^64-1 grains on the last rank's accounting, about eighteen quintillion, more rice than the world grows in centuries. The legend's king agrees square by square because early terms look like nothing. Every exponential scam and viral curve replays the same misunderstanding of the back half of the board.
source_hint: Chessboard and wheat legend (medieval, retold widely)
